data.name: Help_Dashboard_Description
data.value: The Dashboard is the first screen you see after signing in. It summarizes what matters most across every module in one place.

data.name: Help_Dashboard_Purpose
data.value: Give you a fast, accurate snapshot of today's business performance without navigating into individual modules.

data.name: Help_Dashboard_Overview
data.value: Key Metrics cards show bookings, active clients, revenue, and pending tasks with trend indicators. Quick Actions let you jump straight into common tasks. Recent Activity lists the latest changes across the app.

data.name: Help_Dashboard_WhenToUse
data.value: Open the Dashboard whenever you start your day, or whenever you want a quick health check of the business without digging through reports.

data.name: Help_Dashboard_Steps
data.value: Review the Key Metrics cards at the top for today's numbers. Use a Quick Action button to start a new booking, add a customer, or create a task. Scroll down to Recent Activity to see what changed recently.

data.name: Help_Dashboard_Tips
data.value: Trend arrows next to each metric show whether it improved or declined compared to the previous period. The Business Assistant panel on the right will surface AI-powered insights in a future update.

data.name: Help_Dashboard_Warnings
data.value: Dashboard figures refresh when the page loads - use Retry if a widget shows an error instead of data.

data.name: Help_Dashboard_BestPractices
data.value: Check the Dashboard first thing each day to catch anything that needs attention before it becomes urgent.

data.name: Help_Dashboard_Notes
data.value: Some metrics may take a moment to load the first time you open the Dashboard in a session.

data.name: Help_Customers_Subtitle
data.value: Search, review, and manage every client relationship

data.name: Help_Customers_Description
data.value: The Customers module is your CRM - every client's profile, statistics, tags, notes, and activity history in one place.

data.name: Help_Customers_Purpose
data.value: Keep a complete, searchable record of every customer so any team member can quickly understand the relationship.

data.name: Help_Customers_Overview
data.value: The left side lists every customer with search; the right side shows the selected customer's full 360 profile, including status, statistics, tags, notes, and a timeline of recent activity.

data.name: Help_Customers_WhenToUse
data.value: Use this module whenever you need to add a new customer, look up contact details, update their status, or review their history before a call or appointment.

data.name: Help_Customers_Steps
data.value: Use the search box to find a customer by name, company, or email. Select a customer from the list to open their full profile on the right. Update their status, add tags, or add a note directly from the profile panel. Use the Add Customer form to register a brand-new client.

data.name: Help_Customers_Tips
data.value: Tags help you segment customers (e.g. VIP, Lead) for quick visual identification in the list. The Statistics cards update automatically as the customer's bookings and purchases change.

data.name: Help_Customers_Warnings
data.value: Changing a customer's status affects how they're counted in reports - confirm before saving.

data.name: Help_Customers_BestPractices
data.value: Add a note after every meaningful interaction so the whole team stays informed.

data.name: Help_Customers_Notes
data.value: Customer records are shared across the organization's branches according to your permission level.

data.name: Help_Bookings_Description
data.value: The Bookings module manages the full appointment lifecycle, from creation to completion or cancellation.

data.name: Help_Bookings_Purpose
data.value: Ensure every appointment is scheduled, tracked, and resolved without conflicts or missed follow-ups.

data.name: Help_Bookings_Overview
data.value: Create a new booking directly from the form, or use the guided Booking Wizard for a step-by-step flow. The list on the left shows every booking; the panel on the right shows full details and status actions for the selected one.

data.name: Help_Bookings_WhenToUse
data.value: Use this module to schedule a new appointment, check today's schedule, or update a booking's status as it progresses.

data.name: Help_Bookings_Steps
data.value: Click New Booking (Wizard) for a guided step-by-step booking flow, or fill in the quick form for a fast entry. Select a booking from the list to view its full details. Use Confirm, Complete, or Cancel to move the booking through its lifecycle.

data.name: Help_Bookings_Tips
data.value: The Booking Wizard checks specialist availability automatically so you avoid double-booking. Duration is shown in minutes and factors directly into the customer's total appointment time.

data.name: Help_Bookings_Warnings
data.value: Cancelling a booking cannot be undone - confirm with the customer before cancelling.

data.name: Help_Bookings_BestPractices
data.value: Confirm a booking as soon as it's created so the schedule reflects reality accurately.

data.name: Help_Bookings_Notes
data.value: Completed bookings feed directly into Accounting and Commission calculations.

data.name: Help_Inventory_Subtitle
data.value: Track products, stock levels, and supplier sourcing

data.name: Help_Inventory_Description
data.value: The Inventory module manages your product catalog, stock levels, suppliers, categories, and the services that consume stock.

data.name: Help_Inventory_Purpose
data.value: Prevent stockouts and give you full visibility into what you have, what you're low on, and where it comes from.

data.name: Help_Inventory_Overview
data.value: The Low Stock summary flags items needing attention. Add categories, suppliers, and new products from the quick-add forms. Select any product to see its stock level, recent transactions, and linked services.

data.name: Help_Inventory_WhenToUse
data.value: Use this module to add new stock, record a sale or restock, check what's running low, or link a product to the services that consume it.

data.name: Help_Inventory_Steps
data.value: Add a category and supplier first if they don't already exist. Use the New Product form to register an item with its SKU, price, and initial quantity. Record a transaction (restock, sale, adjustment) whenever stock changes. Link the product to any services that consume it under Linked Services.

data.name: Help_Inventory_Tips
data.value: The Low Stock Items count updates automatically as transactions are recorded. SKU codes should be unique and consistent to make searching faster.

data.name: Help_Inventory_Warnings
data.value: Recording a transaction with the wrong type (e.g. Sold instead of Adjustment) will skew your stock reports.

data.name: Help_Inventory_BestPractices
data.value: Reconcile stock counts regularly against a physical count to catch discrepancies early.

data.name: Help_Inventory_Notes
data.value: Reorder Threshold determines when a product appears in the Low Stock summary.

data.name: Help_Accounting_Description
data.value: The Accounting module handles invoices, payments, receipts, and the point-of-sale checkout flow.

data.name: Help_Accounting_Purpose
data.value: Give you an accurate, real-time view of revenue, outstanding balances, and every transaction's paper trail.

data.name: Help_Accounting_Overview
data.value: Revenue KPI cards summarize total, today's, and outstanding revenue. New Sale (POS) opens a guided checkout flow. The invoice list on the left links to full line-item, payment, and receipt detail on the right.

data.name: Help_Accounting_WhenToUse
data.value: Use this module to process a new sale, look up an invoice, record a payment, or review outstanding balances.

data.name: Help_Accounting_Steps
data.value: Click New Sale (POS) to start a guided checkout: add products/services, choose a payment method, and charge the customer. Select an invoice from the list to review its line items, payments, and receipts. Use Cancel Invoice if a sale needs to be voided.

data.name: Help_Accounting_Tips
data.value: The POS flow calculates change due automatically once you enter the amount tendered. Outstanding balance on the Revenue card highlights invoices that still need to be collected.

data.name: Help_Accounting_Warnings
data.value: Cancelling an invoice cannot be reversed - make sure it's the correct one before confirming.

data.name: Help_Accounting_BestPractices
data.value: Reconcile daily revenue against the POS summary at the end of each shift.

data.name: Help_Accounting_Notes
data.value: A completed booking can be linked directly into a POS sale to save re-entering customer and service details.

data.name: Help_Services_Subtitle
data.value: Browse and manage your service catalog and specialists

data.name: Help_Services_Description
data.value: The Services module is your catalog of bookable services - categories, duration, pricing, and which specialists can perform each one.

data.name: Help_Services_Purpose
data.value: Keep an accurate, organized service menu that Bookings, the POS, and Reporting all rely on.

data.name: Help_Services_Overview
data.value: The catalog on the left is searchable by name or category. Selecting a service shows its full profile - category, status, duration, price, description, and the specialists assigned to it.

data.name: Help_Services_WhenToUse
data.value: Use this module to look up a service's price or duration, or to assign a specialist who can perform it.

data.name: Help_Services_Steps
data.value: Use the search box to find a service by name or category. Select a service to view its full profile on the right. Use the Assign field to add a specialist who can perform this service.

data.name: Help_Services_Tips
data.value: Duration set here is what the Booking Wizard uses to check specialist availability. Category groups services together for filtering and reporting.

data.name: Help_Services_Warnings
data.value: Removing a specialist from a service does not cancel their existing bookings for it.

data.name: Help_Services_BestPractices
data.value: Keep pricing and duration up to date - they flow directly into invoices and scheduling.

data.name: Help_Services_Notes
data.value: A service's Status (e.g. Active, Seasonal, Discontinued) controls whether it can be selected for new bookings.

data.name: Help_Default_Description
data.value: This screen doesn't have a dedicated help topic yet. Here are some general tips for using ROJAN Desktop.

data.name: Help_Default_Purpose
data.value: Provide baseline guidance until a topic dedicated to this screen is published.

data.name: Help_Default_Overview
data.value: Every module in ROJAN Desktop follows the same pattern: a searchable list on one side, and full details for the selected item on the other. Look for Quick Actions, status badges, and action buttons for common tasks.

data.name: Help_Default_WhenToUse
data.value: Use this general guidance whenever you land on a screen without its own dedicated help topic.

data.name: Help_Default_Steps
data.value: Look for a search box to filter the list on this screen. Select an item from the list to see its full details. Use the action buttons in the detail panel to make changes.

data.name: Help_Default_Tips
data.value: Hover over a status badge or icon to learn what it means.

data.name: Help_Default_Warnings
data.value: Actions that cannot be undone (like cancelling or deleting) usually ask for confirmation first.

data.name: Help_Default_BestPractices
data.value: If you're unsure what a field does, check Related Topics for a module that covers a similar workflow.

data.name: Help_Default_Notes
data.value: More detailed help for this screen is planned for a future update.
